When not being controlled and manipulated by alghollthus, ulat-kinis have found they can develop formidable psychic powers. Those who master this craft are dubbed “mindreavers” by their awestruck kin. **[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 25 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 23 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 20 [Ulat-Kini Mindreaver](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2693) **Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 83 **Perception** +14; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Languages** [Alghollthu](/Languages.aspx?ID=24), [Undercommon](/Languages.aspx?ID=11); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=37) 30 feet **Skills** [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +15, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +15, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +12 **Str** +1 **Dex** +3 **Con** +3 **Int** +1 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +6 **Items** [_pendant of the occult_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=450) --- **AC** 22 **Fort** +12 **Ref** +12 **Will** +16 **HP** 100 **Resistances** [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) 10 --- **Speed** 20 feet, swim 40 feet **Melee** claw +14, **Damage** 1d6+3 slashing **Melee** fangs +12, **Damage** 2d4+3 piercing **Occult Spontaneous Spells** DC 22 - **Cantrips (3rd)** [Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Guidance](/Spells.aspx?ID=142), [Message](/Spells.aspx?ID=190), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280), [Telekinetic Projectile](/Spells.aspx?ID=334) - **1st** [Alarm](/Spells.aspx?ID=7), [Déjà Vu](/Spells.aspx?ID=684), [Ill Omen](/Spells.aspx?ID=696) (3 slots) - **2nd** [Blood Vendetta](/Spells.aspx?ID=675), [Soothe](/Spells.aspx?ID=291), [Telekinetic Maneuver](/Spells.aspx?ID=333) (3 slots) - **3rd** [Agonizing Despair](/Spells.aspx?ID=665), [Phantom Pain](/Spells.aspx?ID=220), [Sculpt Sound](/Spells.aspx?ID=714) (2 slots) - **4th** [Clairvoyance](/Spells.aspx?ID=40), [Seal Fate](/Spells.aspx?ID=715) **Psychic Daze** ([Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Psychic](/Traits.aspx?ID=430)) The mindreaver targets one creature within 120 feet and violently intrudes into their mind. The target attempts a DC 22 Will save.
**Critical Success** The target creature is unaffected.
**Success** The target creature gains weakness 1 to mental damage for 1 minute. If they already have weakness to mental damage, the value of the weakness increases by one.
**Failure** The target creature takes 2d10 mental damage and gains weakness 1 to mental damage for 1 minute. If they already have weakness to mental damage, the value of the weakness increases by one.
**Critical Failure** As failure, except the target's weakness to mental damage increases by 2.
Ulat-Kini Culture The creatures who surface humanoids consider scum still hold grand empires beneath the waves. While some ulat-kinis still revere the alghollthu who created them and others have learned to hate their creators, there are ulat-kinis who have found a new way forward. They have developed their own culture outside of alghollthu influence, founding new underwater traditions and creating new cultural standards.
